request: Show all authentication failures from last 24 hours
title: Failed Logins

intent.text: Show all authentication failures from last 24 hours

generated_spl.title: Failed Logins
generated_spl.spl:
((index=auth sourcetype=linux_secure) OR (index=wineventlog sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security")) action IN ("failure", "failed", "fail")
| stats count AS failures dc(src) AS distinct_sources values(src) AS sources latest(_time) AS last_seen BY user
| sort - failures
| head 25
| convert ctime(last_seen)

dashboard_components.title: Brute Force Attack Detection
dashboard_components.description: Sources generating many failed logins within a short window.
dashboard_components.spl:
((index=auth sourcetype=linux_secure) OR (index=wineventlog sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security")) action IN ("failure", "failed", "fail")
| bin _time span=5m
| stats count AS failures dc(user) AS targeted_accounts values(user) AS accounts BY _time src
| where failures >= 20
| sort - failures

| sort - lockouts
| convert ctime(last_lockout)
